about:
46Solutions is based in Lexington, Kentucky, and operates as a 100% employee-owned technology services firm. The company provides IT, cybersecurity, and audio/video solutions for businesses and homes across central Kentucky.

The firm delivers a range of managed IT services including cybersecurity, network consulting, cloud management, VoIP phone systems, and digital signage. On the residential side, it designs and installs home theaters, outdoor entertainment systems, TV and projector setups, and whole-home automation. With a staff of about 100 and over 300 years of combined team experience, 46Solutions serves small to medium-sized businesses and households throughout the Lexington, Louisville, and surrounding county areas.

Clients come from sectors such as financial services, construction, and physical security. The company cites work with Alltech on a video wall installation and with Silent Guard Security for managed IT and conference-room technology. It also supports residential customers seeking custom home entertainment and automation.

46Solutions emphasizes its employee-ownership model and SOC 2 Type II certification as key differentiators, along with 24/7 phone and email support and recognition as a top IT firm in the Lexington market.
